package dcs

// The same shape written with literals instead of consts.

import (
	"os"

	"github.com/go-authn/secretsource"
)

func password() (string, error) {
	if ref := os.Getenv("WEFT_DCS_PASSWORD_FROM"); ref != "" {
		return secretsource.Resolve(ref)
	}
	return os.Getenv("WEFT_DCS_PASSWORD"), nil
}

func token() string { return os.Getenv("WEFT_DCS_TOKEN") }
